name: benchmark-36
description: The 36-case benchmark: every supported definition on NVIDIA Q1 and Q2 FY2027 and Anthropic's S-1 as a passing case, plus adversarial variants (another column of the same row, an invented row ID, a dropped input, the wrong report in the answer, the adjusted_operating_income add-back refused under M-1, unsupported definitions and an unknown report). Three simple-FCF figures are drafts: derived from documented lines, printed in no document.
